learning_outcomes.text: Identify where AI adds value across planning, inventory and logistics
Use AI to assist demand sensing and planning with human verification
Apply AI to logistics optimisation and exception management responsibly
Recognise data-quality, bias and over-automation risks in supply-chain AI
Keep human control, controls and auditability over AI-assisted planning

integrative_case: A supply-chain planner must introduce AI to a planning process: choose where AI helps demand sensing and route planning, keep the final plan decision human, protect commercial data, and present a governance plan to the operations director showing where AI must not run unchecked.
assesses: knowledge and applied reasoning on every in-scope outcome via MCQ/MR
case-based decisions in the integrative case
